notes.aggregation: median of per-run means; ranges and individual runs retained
notes.component_cpu: subject plus waited children; dependencies and client reported separately
notes.whole_cpu: six daemon own counters plus one-shot program children; mixed outer interval only
notes.tls_cpu: HTTP daemon; entire invocation includes counted warm-up and SSH sampling
notes.rss: not PSS/USS; shared mappings can be counted more than once
notes.idle_after_memory: includes raw output on tmpfs; use idle-before for main memory comparison
notes.page_cache: integrity verification reads full executables and reference copies; MemAvailable is conditional on this cache state
notes.common_tls: one boot per implementation; measured after primary samples
